context_control: Rotate contexts by one complete row, preserving position; mapping fixed without observing responses. Wrong source is(h+1) mod9 at the correct state.
geometry: Source span is orthonormal QR of each head output projection. At the unperturbed pre-MLP state, form exact derivative of native bilinear write composed with RMSNorm, restricted to that span. Output basis is its left singular vectors, chosen without finite-response labels. Frozen global output bases are H233 all-head response bases.
prediction: For every basis, separately evaluate projection of exact finite response (oracle geometric coverage) and projection of the correct native full tangent response (prediction without changed-output inputs). Wrong-chart comparisons vary output basis only; their predicted coefficients still use the current-state native tangent. Full tangent is an additional reference.

gates.locally_compact: Matched rank16 captures>=.80 pooled response energy at both scales and improves over global16 by>=.20.
gates.context_specific: Matched rank16 exceeds wrong-context rank16 coverage by>=.10 at both scales.
gates.source_specific: Matched rank16 exceeds wrong-source rank16 coverage by>=.10 at both scales.
gates.small_change_prediction: Full tangent fidelity>=.99 at scale.05, and independently checked analytic derivative relative error<=1e-4.

cost: Per state/source construct1152x128 derivative matrix from native weights and perform SVD. A rank-r chart stores1152*r numbers per state/source. This is expensive model-derived geometry, not a recovered cheap router, shared global feature list, or semantic unit.
